FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What are your opening hours?
We are open daily from 7:30 AM until midnight (12:00 AM). Whether you're an early bird or a night owl, CHAI has a cozy spot for you.
Do you offer delivery?
Yes! We partner with Tooters and Talabat for delivery. You can also call us directly at 0776 925 5592 for takeaway or pick-up orders.
Where are you located?
We're in Basra, Basra Governorate, حي عمان - قرب محمصة سليمان. You can find us easily on Google Maps.
Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
Absolutely. Many of our baked goods and drinks can be made vegetarian or vegan. Just ask our friendly staff.
Can I reserve a table or host an event?
We accept small group reservations. For private events, please contact us via phone or Instagram DM.
